claim: A sharing account can have at most 250 pending invitations by default; the quota applies only to accounts sharing with accounts outside their AWS organization, a receiving account has no quota on pending invitations, and invitations are not used when sharing within an organization that has resource sharing turned on.
question: How many pending AWS RAM invitations can a sharing account have, and when does the quota apply?

qualifiers.condition: only for sharing with accounts outside the same organization
